_comment: FL-150 is the filer's financial statement. DV-100 page 13: "If you are asking for child support or spousal support you must also complete form FL-150." Every field is the filer's except the case number, which the court fills in, and the four footer buttons, which are not questions. Names follow the answer, not the form: the caption's party block, the two parties, the court's street address, the filer's age (item 2a), the lawyer's name (item 15 signature) and the number of children (item 16a) carry the names DV-100 and DV-105 already ask them under; everything the packet never asks is fl150_. Columns and rows are read from the rectangles (pipeline-field-labels.js), not the XFA names: item 5 is a last-month column at x=482 and an average-monthly column at x=530; item 12 prints five rows of name, age, relationship, income and a Yes/No; item 14 six rows whose boxes are numbered across the row (TextField 1-12, FillText 1-12, DateField 1-6); item 13 is two columns, a-g at x=257 and h-s at x=517. Item 7's second box is 'business partner' though the label-finder reads '(specify):'. The config lists item 14 before items 13p-s so the interview asks the debts before their total, and the page-3 attorney name beside the header so the lawyer is asked with the lawyer's other details.
